arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM main.Patient AS p
JOIN main.Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.PT < 14
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16
LIMIT 1
